'''Dalern''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Mantellian Separatist]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] during the [[Separatist War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which was backing the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]]. He was stationed in the [[Separatist Base]] on [[Mannett Point]] when a [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|promising Republic trooper]] [[Mission to Mannett Point (Havoc Squad)|infiltrated]] the base and was eventually captured by the trooper along with a [[Zora|teammate]]. The Republic soldiers attempted to retrieve info from Dalern but the former proved useless and so, Zora executed him where he stood.<ref name="TOR" />
